purpose: Requirement-specific acceptance conditions for the approved frontend plan; definition artifact only, no completion claim.
scope_policy: Preserve each original requirement. Source/design definitions need relevant source or definition evidence; interaction, persistence and artifact claims need corresponding actual outcomes. Physical-device and native assistive-technology checks remain separately dispositioned when relevant, rather than prerequisites imposed on unrelated narrow source requirements.
existing_evidence_policy: Candidate paths were checked to exist when this file was prepared. Candidates are discovery links only: their report scope, results and source freshness must be inspected before any acceptance decision.

items.requirement: Restore original button text and availability after failures without leaving the interface permanently disabled or deceptively successful.

evidence_needed: Scoped source inspection and rendered or interaction evidence addressing the stated conditions.
Record the specific surfaces, fixtures, state variants and source snapshot covered; a linked candidate is not itself an acceptance result.
items.remaining_gap: Exercise remaining action-family failure paths rather than inferring recovery from shared button styling.
